set.body:
Scope: ../mvpa4s; modules/mvpa core, tests, fixtures and reusable fit-independent pattern/operator code.

Deliverable: Create an independent JVM/JS build and move the identified evidence, relational/pattern analysis and measurement core with its tests and resources. Define narrow validated public boundaries instead of widening unsafe constructors.

Acceptance:
- Standalone mvpa4s builds/tests on both platforms without ScalaFIM production or test dependencies.
- Parity/known-truth, RDM normalization/sign, dense/operator and ownership/lifetime tests move with their implementation.
- Public import/constructor examples compile from an external consumer; no relocated implementation remains active in ScalaFIM.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U4: Bootstrap mvpa4s and move its scientific core
